description: Start a claim of one Instagram or TikTok creator handle for the caller's organization, or return the claim the organization already holds. The claim waits in review with a verificationCode: the creator sends that code by direct message from the claimed profile, and the Starcovery team approves it. Returns a tool error naming the reason when no catalog profile has the handle, another organization holds or is claiming it, a takedown covers it, or the organization already has its limit of claims in review. Needs a credential.

handle.description: The creator handle to claim, without @

platform.description: ig for Instagram or tt for TikTok

name: start_handle_claim
title: Start handle claim
